plainTranslation: {{personA}}'s affection may make it easier to feel liked in your own skin. The warmth is available, but it deepens when someone makes it visible.
summaryShort: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with how freely you present yourself and enter situations.
summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with how freely you present yourself and enter situations. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The warmth can remain polite or surface-level if no one gives it a clearer shape.
advice: Say what feels good, and name what you enjoy about each other.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Authored to cover planet-to-angle synastry fallback for the relationship interaspect list.
